use_unittypes_get_id: use UnitTypes.get_id to look up the numeric ID for a named unit type like PEASANT or DRAGON
check_good_inst_mask: check if an instruction index is in the good_inst_mask numpy array for valid AI actions
check_better_inst_mask: check if an instruction index is in the better_inst_mask numpy array for improved AI actions
use_cmdtypes_enum: use the CmdTypes enum to represent command types like ATTACK, GATHER, BUILD_UNIT, or MOVE
use_ruleaction_enum: use the RuleAction enum to represent rule-based AI actions like BUILD_PEASANT, SCOUT, or DEFEND
